note: 四位新增的職務 NPC（醫師、營養師、文化工作者、地質學家）的閒聊台詞；他們的任務仍是佔位。

lines.zh: 下水前先看海況，身體不舒服就不要下去。
lines.en: Check the sea first before going in. If you don't feel well, stay out.

lines.zh: 島上沒有大醫院，小傷也要好好處理。
lines.en: There's no big hospital on the island. Take care of even small injuries.

lines.zh: 晚上有急事，先打衛生所的電話。
lines.en: If something urgent happens at night, call the health station first.

greet.en: Hi! Want to talk about food?

lines.zh: 芋頭、地瓜、飛魚，搭配起來營養很完整。
lines.en: Taro, sweet potato and flying fish together make a very complete meal.

lines.zh: 泡麵方便，可是不能天天吃喔。
lines.en: Instant noodles are handy, but not every day!

lines.zh: 晚餐吃清淡一點，明天比較有精神。
lines.en: Eat something light for dinner and you'll have more energy tomorrow.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

lines.zh: 想認識部落，先學會問：可以嗎？
lines.en: To get to know a village, first learn to ask: "Is this okay?"

lines.zh: 有些地方是聖地，遠遠看就好。
lines.en: Some places are sacred. Just look from afar.

lines.zh: 晚上部落裡的故事，要長輩願意說，才可以聽。
lines.en: Village stories at night are only for listening when the elders want to tell them.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的灘頭，訪客不要進去。
lines.en: In flying fish season, visitors should stay off the boat beach.

greet.en: Oh, hello! Look at this rock —

lines.zh: 蘭嶼是火山島，這些黑色的岩石都是很久以前的熔岩。
lines.en: Lanyu is a volcanic island. These black rocks are lava from long, long ago.

lines.zh: 海浪把岩石切成各種形狀，族人也給它們取了名字。
lines.en: The waves cut the rocks into all kinds of shapes, and the Tao people gave them names.

lines.zh: 晚上我就整理白天的筆記。
lines.en: At night I sort out my notes from the day.
